column1: # The container profiles of NF Hotel (MIL-080), read by ops/scripts/check-container-runtime.sh: one
# row per compose service under ops/deploy that runs on the VM nf-hotel, in the monitoring LXC
# nf-monitoring or on the backup host. A container is matched by the folder of its compose file
# under ops/deploy and its compose service, so the throwaway stack of CI uses the same rows. A
# running container without a row breaks the rule "profile".
# Tab separated, eight columns, "-" for none:
#   folder      the folder of the compose file under ops/deploy
#   service     the compose service
#   user        the effective user of the main process: nonroot (any user but 0), root (any user,
#               root included) or a user ID
#   caps        the capabilities it may hold, its cap_add, comma separated without CAP_; "default"
#               is the default set of Docker, for a service that does not drop it
#   rootfs      ro, or rw for a writable root filesystem
#   host_paths  the sensitive host paths it may mount read-only (SENSITIVE in the check), the
#               Docker socket included
#   writable    the folders in the container where it may mount a host folder writable
#   exempt      the rules that do not apply to it, with the reason in the comment above the row
# To change a row: change the compose file and the row in the same pull request, with the reason in
# a comment; CI compares the rows with the compose files and runs the check over the throwaway stack,
# and the deploy checks the release on the VM (wiki page Host-Hardening).
# The virtual machine nf-hotel (ops/scripts/deploy-services.sh).
# PostgreSQL starts as root and drops to its user (70); its entrypoint needs the five capabilities to
# give the data folder to that user.
postgres
nfhotel-api
nfhotel-web
# The nginx master runs as root to bind ports 80 and 443 (CIS-001 row 4.1); its workers run as nginx.
nginx
# Ollama runs as root because its image does.
ollama
market-analysis
benchmark
# A one-shot service as root: it gives the results volume to the user of the image and exits (MIL-045).
benchmark
cloudflared

# The one container with the Docker socket (ADR-0020); HAProxy runs as root, the owner of the socket.
alloy
# Alloy reads the host's metrics and journal through read-only mounts, as 473 without the group of
# the socket, so it sees the socket file and cannot open it.
alloy
# The monitoring in the LXC nf-monitoring (ops/scripts/deploy-monitoring.sh).
